meta_description: Dragon Warmth Solutions is your trusted plumber in Warrington. Emergency repairs, boiler installations, and heating services available 24/7. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Response — Burst Pipes Fixed Same Day
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 2am in Warrington? We arrive within the hour, any day, any time. No call-out charge.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Warrington
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to full boiler installations, we handle every plumbing job with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipe Repair
services.desc: Burst pipe flooding your home? We respond within the hour, locate the damage fast, and make temporary or permanent repairs. No call-out charge on emergency callouts.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Upgrade
services.desc: New boiler fitted and commissioned with a 10-year parts guarantee. We handle all paperwork, advise on efficiency ratings, and install condensing models that lower your bills.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Bleeding
services.desc: Cold radiators or leaking valves slow you down. We diagnose the fault, bleed air, replace thermostatic valves, or fit new radiators—keeping your home warm through winter.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Full suite installations, tap replacement, and pipe relocation. We manage supply lines, waste routes, and connections so everything works flawlessly from day one.

services.title: Leaking Tap & Fitting Repairs
services.desc: Dripping taps waste thousands of litres yearly and hike your bill. We replace washers, cartridges, or fit new taps quickly—often the same day you call.

services.title: Central Heating System Servicing
services.desc: Annual boiler and system checks keep efficiency high and breakdowns rare. We clean pipes, flush radiators, test pressure, and spot faults before they become costly emergencies.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was fed up seeing cowboys overcharge my neighbours.
about_para_1: Dragon Warmth Solutions was founded 18 years ago on a simple promise: turn up on time, fix the job properly, and never rip customers off. Since then, we've completed over 2,000 plumbing and heating jobs across Warrington and the surrounding areas. Our reputation is built on showing up when we say we will and leaving your home warmer and drier than we found it.
about_para_2: We're a lean, hardworking team—no fancy office, no hidden charges. When you call us at 2am with a burst pipe, you get a real plumber who knows Warrington inside out, not an operator in a call centre. Repeat customers make up over 70% of our work, and that tells you everything about how we treat people.
reviews_heading: What Warrington Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a leaking radiator before Christmas. Dave came out the same evening and had it sorted in 45 minutes. Brilliant bloke, fair price, and didn't try to sell me stuff I didn't need. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Burst pipe at half two in the morning—absolute panic. Called Dragon Warmth and they were here by 3:15. Fixed it, cleaned up, explained what happened. No faffing about, just got it done. Top job, honestly.
reviews.author: Helen K.

reviews.text: New boiler fitted start to finish in one day. The lads were tidy, explained everything, and they handled all the paperwork. Ten-year guarantee gives me peace of mind. Couldn't ask for better service.
reviews.author: Simon P.
